description: This file configures and manages USB-over-serial communication, initializing the USB CDC driver, controlling USB connection state, and checking if the serial interface is ready.

methods.name: usb_serial_start
methods.description: Initializes and activates the USB serial-over-CDC driver, including hardware connection management and driver startup.

methods.name: is_usb_serial_ready
methods.description: Checks whether the USB serial interface has been initialized and is in the active state.
